title: Sea level as a subsurface indicator
query:
Assess how reliably sea-surface height identifies subsurface thermal structure in the Gulf of Mexico. Evaluate its relationship with thermocline depth and upper-ocean heat content, and identify conditions under which the relationship becomes unreliable.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
